latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Free API Skill

- Upload text prompts (TXT, DOCX, JSON, CSV, up to 500MB) and generate ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos with visuals and music.
- Supports fast, automated video creation for developers and marketers—no paid API plan needed.
- Includes free anonymous token generation for new users (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Simple prompt-based workflow: upload, describe your video, and download the result in about 1–2 minutes.
- API covers upload, video generation, session management, credits, timeline editing, and exports.
- Clear user-oriented feedback, error handling, and status updates built in.
